**Functional prediction: CemA, a chloroplast inner-membrane protein.** The 229-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed *Ipomoea purpurea* CemA (UniProt **A7Y3F4**) and contains the CemA Pfam domain (PF03040). Its hydrophobic regions and annotated helical transmembrane segments support a multi-pass membrane-protein assignment.

Curated annotations describe CemA as contributing to **light-dependent K⁺/H⁺ antiport and proton efflux**, helping maintain chloroplast proton homeostasis. It is also associated with modulation of photosynthesis and non-photochemical quenching; improved inorganic-carbon uptake is described as an indirect effect. These functional details are supported by the exact reference match and its curated annotation.
